root_cause: http_owner_artifact_lister parsed the registry page token with int() (fails on k1: keyset tokens) and read every approved artifact one by one (670 on hosted, 5s timeout each).

fix.lister: one /api/registry/lineage?root_id=<persona>&depth=1 read returns the artifacts bound to the persona, then one owner-record read per bound artifact; truncated lineage fails closed; verification against the owner record unchanged; zero or several candidates still refuse in seed_from_owner_records
fix.probe_exclusion: is_probe_or_test_persona mirrors persona_evaluator_agent._probe_persona (parity test); skipped as not_eligible release_probe_or_test_persona_not_enrolled before any owner write
fix.backoff: refused/unavailable enrolments retry at most every PANTHEON_PERSONA_ENROLLMENT_RETRY_SECONDS (default 600 = 6 per hour per persona); readback keeps latest reason and attempted_at; success still happens without operator action

not_verified: hosted deployment; hosted probe personas are assumed to match the evaluator probe rule (name/metadata), unverifiable from the worktree
